underlines.text: that Wickham should marry a girl whom it was impossible he could marry for money

reference.text: His choice is disinterested at least, for he must know my father can give her nothing.
Could she exert herself, it would be better, but this is not to be expected; and as to my father, I never in my life saw him so affected.

underlines.text: supposing, by the servant’s account, that their niece was taken suddenly ill

reference.text: Calling back the servant, therefore, she commissioned him, though in so breathless an accent as made her almost unintelligible, to fetch his master and mistress home instantly.
